Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body:
Stealing is not equipping:
groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/browse_thread/thread/3b9f76ef43b38692/b5f18d97d2057af9?lnk=gst&q=lsj+steal+equipment#b5f18d97d2057af9

his ability may be one sentence to save on cardtext, but it's two different clauses. so I would say it's two different abilities, which can both be attempted in the same turn if he untaps.
groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/browse_thread/thread/f4c9f542e783d48e/a11f994775221ce6
Virstania is the closest example: she gives gargoyles 2 abilities that are also written together in a single sentence, but LSJ has ruled that both can be used seperately.
(this question seems to depend more on english sentence structure than game rules, yay)

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Reyda wrote:
> Oh Hai.
> If I untap Annazir after having stolen an equipment, can I go and burn a location or is it considered "having already used this card's buit in action" ?
>
It does count as using one of Annazir's built-in actions, but you can still use the other one.
>
> Reyda wrote:
> And as a sidenote, If i "steal an equipment" and this equipement is an untapped helicopter, do I tap it or does it stay untapped for more funky actions ?
>
> thanks !
>
> Reminder text :
> Independent: Annazir has 2 votes (titled). He may burn a location or steal an equipment as a action. +1 bleed. Infernal.
>
An action to steal an equipment isn't an action to equip. If Annazir steals a Helicopter via his ability, the Helicopter doesn't tap. Similarly, an action to diablerize someone with an equipment isn't an action to equip, even though you may have some new equipment in the end.

Messages.Author: Miasmat
Messages.Body:
So, for Bulscu and Sebastian Goulet, the action is actually "steal", not "steal a retainer", "steal an ally", "steal a location" or "steal an equipment". But for Annazir, the actions are "steal" or "burn", so he has 2 actions.

I like that clarification.
